items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying, Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
items.claim: The LORD instructed Moses to number all male Levites from one month old and upward, organized by paternal families.
items.object: children of Levi; every male from a month old and upward
